versions.changelog:
- Removed the obsolete file skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md to include a new "课件生成域概览" section, outlining 5 domains and 19 typical tasks.
- Added a "特有维度" (special dimensions) section, summarizing core influencing factors for courseware generation.
- Minor restructuring of the SKILL.md content for conciseness; removed the directory tree and integrated information into tables.
- Core functional and process descriptions remain unchanged.

- Removed the file skill-card.md to streamline the repository.
- No feature or functionality changes; skills and documentation remain unchanged.
- Simplified project structure by eliminating unnecessary files.

- Initial release of the courseware-generation skill.
- Provides end-to-end courseware creation, including full design specifications, template system, and content generation.
- Supports multiple courseware types: PPT, teaching, training, and online courseware.
- Features a structured execution framework: demand analysis, planning, content generation, and file output.
- Includes built-in templates, design style systems (color, font, layout), and usage rules to ensure professionalism and usability.
